sehemu: Part I: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and the President of Zanzibar
jina: The Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar and its jurisdiction
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Government of Zanzibar to be known as the "Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar" which shall have authority in Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution. (2) Without prejudice to the provisions of this Article and the succeeding Articles of this Chapter, the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar shall be constituted and shall exercise its authority in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar, 1984.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Government of Zanzibar to be known as the "Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar" which shall have authority in Zanzibar over all matters which are not Union Matters in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution.
